T: Every town needs a dog like this.
D: The true-ish story of a wandering red kelpie who united a mining town in the Pilbara.
P: Serve the mains when the miners at the pub start telling Red Dog stories.
S: Dampier pub loaded chicken salt chips
Thick double-fried chips under gravy, melted cheddar and spring onion, where the yarns get spun

Thick double-fried chips hit with chicken salt, smothered in gravy and melted cheddar, with spring onion on top. Cut 1.2kg potatoes into thick chips, fry at 140C for 6 minutes, rest, then at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp. Toss with 2 tsp chicken salt. Make gravy: melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 400ml beef stock and a dash of Worcestershire and simmer until thick. Pile the chips on a tray, scatter with 150g grated cheddar, pour over the hot gravy and top with sliced pickled jalapeño and spring onion.
Cold king prawns with lemon aioli and buttered white bread.

Beat 150g mayonnaise with 2 crushed garlic cloves, the zest and juice of 1 lemon and a pinch of salt. Pile 1.2kg cooked king prawns on a platter over ice with lemon wedges, and serve with the aioli and 8 slices of buttered white bread. Peel as you go.
Garlic and chilli squid grilled hot and fast, finished with lime and coriander
Tender squid scored and charred on a hot barbecue with chilli, garlic and lime. Score 600g cleaned squid tubes and cut into pieces.
M: Dampier sausages, steak and potato salad
Charcoal beef sausages and rump steak, fried onions, mayo potato salad, white bread

Thick beef sausages and rump steaks grilled over coals, onions fried on the hotplate, with potato salad dressed in mayo and chives and a stack of white bread. Boil 1kg potatoes until tender, cool and dress with mayonnaise and chives. Grill 8 thick beef sausages and 4 rump steaks over hot coals. Fry 2 sliced onions on the hotplate until golden. Serve it all with a stack of white bread and the potato salad.
Pilbara grilled barra with lime slaw
Spice-dusted barramundi seared on a hot plate, lime and chilli slaw, pickled onion and tartare

Spice-dusted barramundi seared on a hot plate, served with lime and chilli slaw, pickled red onion and tartare sauce. Mix 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin and salt and rub over 800g barramundi fillets. Pickle 1 sliced red onion in lime juice and salt. Toss a quarter cabbage, shredded, with lime juice, chilli and coriander. Mix 120g mayonnaise with 1 chopped chipotle. Sear the fish in a hot oiled pan for 3 minutes a side and flake. Char 12 small flour tortillas and fill with fish, slaw, onion and mayo.
W: Mine canteen jam roly-poly and custard
Jam rolled in soft pastry, baked and sliced, with hot custard.

Rub 100g cold butter into 250g self-raising flour, mix in 1 tbsp sugar and about 120ml milk to a soft dough, and roll to a 25 x 30cm rectangle. Spread with 150g raspberry jam leaving a 2cm edge, roll up and wrap loosely in baking paper and foil. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Heat 500ml milk with 2 tbsp custard powder and 3 tbsp sugar, whisking until thick, and pour over thick slices.
K: Lager topped with fresh ruby grapefruit soda over ice, soda only for drivers

Ice-cold lager cut half and half with fresh ruby grapefruit soda, red-tinged and sharp, served in frosty stubby holders with a grapefruit wedge. Juice 2 ruby grapefruits and stir with 2 tbsp caster sugar until dissolved, then mix with 400ml cold soda water. Chill well. Half fill 4 tall glasses or stubby holder cups with cold lager, top with the grapefruit soda and add a grapefruit wedge. Serve the grapefruit soda on its own for the drivers.
